rationale: The original thesis relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.18) with rising volume on upward grinds, which has just been violated. The most recent 1-minute bar produced a sharp sell-off from $27.32 to $27.07 on more than quadruple the prior bar's volume (18,612 vs 4,035) after failing to clear the $27.44 session high (MFE reached ~1.29% at $27.43). Closing near breakeven preserves capital as short-term momentum shifts downward, while avoiding a short flip against a stock still holding at 84.6% of its daily range on 4.73x relative volume.
